day_local: Khamiista Toddobaadka Soddon iyo Saddexaad ee Wakhtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Wanka ayaa inaga dhigay boqortooyo wadaaddo ah si aan ugu adeegno Ilaaheenna.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan garoonka diyaaradaha, adigoo daawanaya diyaaradaha oo kor u kacaya, dhawaaqooda oo hawada ruxaya, iyo xamaasadda ka muuqata qofka jecel aviation-ka. Waxaa jira wax gaar ah oo ku saabsan in la arko wax weyn oo hawada u kacaya, wax si xarrago leh u kala dillaacaya daruuraha. Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu lahaa xamaasad noocaas ah. Wuxuu jeclaa diyaaradaha, wuxuuna ku riyoon jiray 'con chim airlines'. Laakiin ka sokow tiknoolajiyadda iyo xisaabta uu ku fiicnaa, waxaa jiray wax ka sii weyn: wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, Yooxanaa wuxuu arkay duub qoran oo la shaabadeeyey, qofna ma awoodin inuu furo. Wuxuu bilaabay inuu ooyo. Laakiin waxaa loo sheegay: 'Ha ooyin. Libaaxii qabiilka Yahuudah wuu guulaystay.' Markaasuu arkay Wanka oo u muuqda sidii mid la gowracay. Wankaas la gowracay, oo ah Ciise, ayaa ah kan kaliya ee furaya sirta nolosha iyo dhimashada. Maanta, waxaan halkan u nimid inaan ku dhex aragno xanuunkeenna 'Wankaas la gowracay'.

Ciise, markuu u soo dhowaaday Yeruusaalem, wuu arkay magaaladii, wuuna u ooyay. Wuxuu yiri: 'Haddii aad maanta garan lahaydeen waxa nabadda keena—laakiin hadda indhihiinna waa laga qariyey.' Ciise wuxuu u ooyay magaalada sababtoo ah waxay seegeen wakhtigii booqashadiisa. Waxay seegeen fursaddii ay ku heli lahaayeen nabadda dhabta ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo maanta, Alan iyo Thao. Shan bilood ayaa ka soo wareegtay tan iyo markii Ben uu u hoyday gacmaha Ilaah. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin, gaar ahaan markaad xasuusataan sida uu u jeclaa inuu idinla wadaago riyadiisa 'con chim airlines'.

Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil doonayay inuu bixiyo wax kasta oo uu haysto. Xusuusta uu aabbihiis ka sheegay ee ku saabsan sida uu u rabay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William, waa tusaale saafi ah oo ah wiil qalbigiisu uu furnaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ilaah ma eego waxa aan bixino, wuxuu eegaa sida aan u bixinno.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah. Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramenta Quduuska ah. Waan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si sacramental ah, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waan ku soo dhoweynayaa sidii adigoo horeyba u joogay, waxaana isku xirayaa naftayda adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabadda uu isagu keligiis bixin karo. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyey ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku dejiyo iftiinka wejigiisa weligiis.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culayska wada, inuu Ilaah ku xoojiyo rajo iyo nabad.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Anigoo Yooxanaa ah, waxaan arkay duub gacanta midig ee kan carshiga ku fadhiya. Waxay lahayd qoraal labada dhinac ah, waxaana lagu shaabadeeyey toddoba shaabaddood. Dabadeed waxaan arkay malaa'ig xoog badan oo cod dheer ku dhawaaqday, 'Yaa u qalma inuu furo duubka oo jebiyo shaabadihiisa?' Laakiin qofna samada ama dhulka ama dhulka hoostiisa kama helin inuu furo duubka ama uu baaro. Waxaan daadiyey ilmo badan sababtoo ah cidna laguma helin inay u qalanto inay furto duubka ama ay baarto. Mid ka mid ah odayaashii ayaa igu yiri, 'Ha ooyin. Libaaxii qabiilka Yahuudah, xididkii Daa'uud, wuu guulaystay, isagoo awood u leh inuu furo duubka iyo toddobadiisa shaabaddood.' Markaas waxaan arkay isagoo taagan dhexda carshiga iyo afarta makhluuq ee nool iyo odayaasha, Wankii oo u muuqday sidii mid la gowracay. Wuxuu lahaa toddoba gees iyo toddoba indhood; kuwanu waa toddobada ruux ee Ilaah oo loo diray dunida oo dhan. Wuxuu u yimid inuu ka qaato duubka gacanta midig ee kan carshiga ku fadhiya. Markuu qaatay, afartii makhluuq ee nool iyo labaatan iyo afartii oday ayaa u sujuuday Wanka hortiisa. Oday walba wuxuu haystay harf iyo baaquli dahab ah oo ay ka buuxaan foox, kuwaas oo ah baryada quduusiinta. Waxay qaadeen hees cusub: 'Waxaad u qalantaa inaad hesho duubka oo aad jebiso shaabadihiisa, waayo waa lagu gowracay, dhiiggaagana waxaad Ilaah ugu iibsatay kuwa ka yimid qabiil kasta iyo carrab kasta, dad kasta iyo quruun kasta. Waxaad ka dhigtay boqortooyo iyo wadaaddo Ilaaheenna, wayna ku boqri doonaan dhulka.'

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Wanka ayaa inaga dhigay boqortooyo wadaaddo ah si aan ugu adeegno Ilaaheenna. U gabya Rabbiga hees cusub, oo ammaan ku dhex jira shirka kuwa aaminka ah. Yaa reer binu Israa'iil ku farxaan abuurahooda, ha ku rayreeyaan carruurta Siyoon boqorkooda. R. Wanka ayaa inaga dhigay boqortooyo wadaaddo ah si aan ugu adeegno Ilaaheenna. Magaciisa ha ku ammaaneen qoob-ka-ciyaarka ciidda, ha ugu gabyeen isaga oo wata durbaan iyo harf. Waayo Rabbigu wuu jecel yahay dadkiisa, wuxuuna kuwa hooseeya ku sharfaa guul. R. Wanka ayaa inaga dhigay boqortooyo wadaaddo ah si aan ugu adeegno Ilaaheenna. Kuwa aaminka ah ha ku rayreeyeen ammaanta; ha ugu gabyeen farxad sariirahooda; ammaanada sare ee Ilaah ha ku jireen dhuumahooda. Tani waa ammaanta dhammaan kuwa aaminka ah. Alleluia. R. Wanka ayaa inaga dhigay boqortooyo wadaaddo ah si aan ugu adeegno Ilaaheenna.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markuu Ciise u soo dhowaaday Yeruusaalem, wuxuu arkay magaaladii, wuuna u ooyay, isagoo leh, 'Haddii aad maanta garan lahaydeen waxa nabadda keena—laakiin hadda indhihiinna waa laga qariyey. Waayo maalmo ayaa kugu soo socda markii cadawgaagu ay kugu dhisi doonaan xayndaab; way kugu hareerayn doonaan oo dhinac walba ayay kaa xiri doonaan. Waxay kugu burburin doonaan dhulka iyo carruurtaada idinku dhex jira, mana ka tagi doonaan dhagax dul saaran dhagax kale sababtoo ah ma aadan aqoonsan wakhtigii booqashadaada.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
